UpgradeAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether a purchasable higher version exists that can accommodate the DesiredTotal. This field is true only when the current version capacity is insufficient and a higher version meets the requirements. Otherwise, it is false. This field may be empty for APP and USER checks. This field does not indicate that an upgrade has been performed or an upgrade order has been created
